microtask-checkpoint.short: The HTML spec step that runs the microtask queue until it is empty. It runs after each task and whenever the JavaScript stack becomes empty after a callback.

rendering-opportunity.short: A moment when the browser can present a new frame, set by the display refresh rate and throttling. Only then does 'update the rendering' run: rAF callbacks, style, layout, paint.

thenable.short: Any object with a then method. Promise machinery adopts its state by calling then in a separate job, which costs extra microtask ticks compared with a native promise.
